rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded/partially collapsed blastocyst with generally good ICM and TE and appropriately notes limits of a single still image; minor overreach in calling it top-tier from the image alone and limited zona-specific detail.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, FSH, endometriosis, first-cycle status, oocyte maturity, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.
Overall logical and internally consistent, with probability estimate tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor issue is treating day-4 blastulation as clearly favorable without enough nuance.

Generally consistent with Gardner grading principles and IVF practice, including preference for single embryo transfer and caution about routine PGT-A at age 26; slight deviation in emphasis on day-4 blastocyst favorability and some speculative points.

Provides practical next steps for transfer optimization, luteal support, SET, and future planning if unsuccessful; useful though some recommendations remain somewhat general rather than protocol-specific.
